Application Data.NAME: Mountain Peak Sporting Goods
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mountain Peak Sporting Goods specializes in the retail sale of a wide range of sporting equipment and apparel, including outdoor gear, fitness equipment, and accessories for various sports. Our store offers expert advice and guidance to customers, ensuring they find the right products for their needs. We also provide instructional services, such as fitness training and outdoor safety workshops, led by certified professionals. Our commitment to customer safety and satisfaction is paramount, and we follow rigorous quality control measures to minimize risks associated with product liability.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2022, a customer reported an injury while using a bicycle rented from our store due to a brake failure. The claim amounted to $10,000 and is currently under review. Additionally, on February 10, 2023, a defective yoga mat caused a slip accident in a fitness class, leading to a claim of $5,000, which has been settled.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, 1-hour fire rating, equipped with a digital keypad lock.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the perimeter, monitored alarm system, and trained watchpersons during peak hours to ensure customer and property safety.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Stores with significant sales or rentals of motorized sporting equipment (e.g., ATVs, jet
skis) without specialized coverage and risk controls.
Key Risk Considerations
• Product Liability: Sporting goods stores face exposure from defective or malfunctioning
products that could cause injury or property damage. For example, a defective bicycle helmet
failing to protect a rider could result in a claim.
• Injury During Instruction: When instructional activities are offered (e.g., archery lessons
or personal training), there is an increased risk of bodily injury claims. Proper certification
and safety protocols are critical to mitigate these risks.
